description: Threshold library of statistics 1.0.0: versioned acceptance rules an auditor adopts as internal policy. A plan references an entry by id and version and stores its parameter values; every result that uses an entry shows its legalStatus and caveat verbatim. Caveats are timeless; facts that can change live in statusNotes, which are shown beside results but never frozen into them, and updating a note does not change the entry version. The hosted runner reads this file (site-app/lib/threshold-library.json is its generated copy); engine/statistics.py mirrors the entries whose kind is a criterion kind, and engine/tests/test_threshold_library.py keeps the two equal. Nothing here is legal advice; legal content stays pending the qualified legal review of #57 (decision D-02).

entries.caveat: Four-fifths screen: a rule of thumb from the US Uniform Guidelines (29 CFR 1607.4(D)), not a legal test of discrimination.

statusNotes.text: The EEOC has sent OIRA a final rule rescinding the Guidelines' interpretive provisions. The rule text is unpublished, and its scope, including whether it removes the four-fifths rule, is unconfirmed (secondary source). The entry stays a configurable screen either way.
